subject: Life Skills

source.topic: Personal and Social Well-being: Safety in the home
source.subtopic: Poisonous substances: types and recognising warning symbols

show.line: Poison can make us very sick. Look for warning symbols. Do not touch!

rounds.prompt: Which symbol means it can catch fire?
Your friend wants to drink from a bottle with a skull. What do you say?

rounds.story: Paraffin is kept in a cold drink bottle. Little Tumi thinks it is cool drink. What is the danger?
rounds.praise: He could drink poison! Keep it in a marked bottle.

hints: Skull means poison. Flame means fire.
Never taste something you do not know.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I see a skull on a bottle.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! A skull means poison.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: The skull means poison. Don't touch!

parent_line: Recognises poison and fire warning symbols.
